title: OperatorSessionKeysChangedPayload
description: Payload of the OperatorSessionKeysChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml; class: domain; feeds runtime replicas). access-svc publishes its operator-session signing keys on their own topic, gst.access.operator-session-keys-changed.v1, subscribed by every service except access-svc, which signs with them and verifies operator tokens from its own key store (coordinator ruling INV-Q-4171); each service's authority replica (service-runtime) consumes them beside AuthorityChanged, with no ordering between the two, keeps them, and verifies an operator-session token (a token carrying `act`) only against these replicated keys, refusing it (401) while the replica holds no valid key (fail closed). getVerificationKeys and getRevocationList stay gateway-only (owner ruling INV-Q-4006 A; coordinator ruling INV-Q-4162; owner ruling INV-Q-4119). access-svc publishes a key before signing with it and keeps the old key until every token it signed has expired. Each event carries the current key and, during rotation, the next key. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

keys.description: The operator-session signing keys: the current key and, during rotation, the next key.

kid.description: Key id, matched against the token header's kid.

alg.description: The JWS signing algorithm (RFC 7518), for example RS256.

publicKey.description: The key's DER X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo (RFC 5280 section 4.1.2.7), standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4), whatever the alg; the same encoding as getVerificationKeys (coordinator ruling INV-Q-4079).
